name: BLUNDER - Test
author: Jarrilinca247
description:
Hi, my name is Dava, and this is a 2D Puzzle Multiplayer Platformer Game.

And I am the game designer for this game Blunder.

This is me and my partners first game published to the public,
so don’t look forward to something amazing in the game, we are beginners after all.

Anyways, thanks for checking out the game, have fun.

(Btw, there will be further updates to the game coming soon)
